nodes.label: Private Register CSS partial (scoped stylesheet, "pe-" prefixed classes)
nodes.rationale: Bespoke scoped styles shared by private-events.html, destinations/, and planners-and-venues.html — deliberately kept separate from the generated site bundle (css/style.css produced by build.sh). The file's first inner line being a comment is what stops build.sh Pass A from converting/inlining it as if it were a normal page style block; a page carrying this partial must never also link the generated site stylesheet, since build.sh Pass B would then inline the whole site CSS bundle on top of these scoped tokens/rules and collide with them. Documented in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-26-private-events-design.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-29-international-luxury-weddings-design.md.
